Definition
[Parabolic Ansatz 2 (36.22)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0342 ↗ def:chow-iv-parabolic-linearization 1. ch36:36.4-ansatz,ch36:36.22\group Matched Asymptotics

For an integer $k\ge 3$, assume \[ V(\sigma ,\tau )=b_ke^{\lambda _k\tau }\sigma ^k +O(e^{\lambda _k\tau }\sigma ^{k-2}) \quad (\sigma \to \infty ), \] with this quantity small throughout the parabolic region. Consequently that region satisfies $|\sigma |\ll e^{(1/2-1/k)\tau }$.
